title: Bolt Review 2026: Pricing, Features, and Honest Verdict
summary: Bolt.new runs a real in-browser dev environment, but it falls short on backend depth, token predictability, and billing. Here's why Blink is the more complete platform for serious builders.
body_markdown: Blink. It covers Bolt's three biggest gaps natively, a database and auth included instead of connecting Supabase separately, flat pricing instead of token drain that scales with iteration, and native Stripe subscription billing instead of no billing system at all, and it's a more complete platform overall: native mobile apps, a customer-facing AI gateway, and built-in growth tooling are all things Bolt doesn't offer at any tier. More options are ranked in our[Bolt alternatives](https://blink.new/blog/bolt-alternatives) roundup.
